runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 10:27 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No candidate cleared all location, language, skill, economics and ranking gates strongly enough for LIVE promotion. LinkedIn surfaced SupportYourApp remote support roles, but the active customer-support result requires fluent English and other visible variants require C1 English or are already closed. KLARSTEIN customer support is Bratislava/remote-from-Slovakia but is explicitly for French-speaking customers, so it is a language hard reject. Profesia surfaced a fresh Bratislava technical-support Team Leader at 3100 EUR, but Linux/server/network leadership scope is materially above the target profile. Public Reddit results were US-only hard-development hiring or FOR-HIRE supply; Facebook public indexing produced 0 verified direct hiring posts. Site-scoped searches of Brigada.sk, Worki, Kariera, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, StartupJobs, Upwork and WordPress Jobs yielded no new promotion-grade public delta in this run.

developmentChanges.title: Stable source-job-ID deduplication
developmentChanges.reason: Extract stable source job identifiers before fuzzy company+title identity so alternate/localized URLs cannot create duplicate LIVE cards.

developmentChanges.title: Dynamic recent-delta fallback
developmentChanges.reason: If a recent-delta manifest is stale or unavailable, derive a bounded fallback rather than silently hiding newly verified records.

developmentChanges.title: Manifest staleness diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: Separate source-verification age, content age and manifest age so an apparently fresh timestamp cannot hide stale evidence.

developmentChanges.title: Safer normalized identity dedupe
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize common legal-form and title boilerplate before final identity comparison while keeping stable IDs intact.

developmentChanges.title: Structured vs detail language reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: When a job board structured field says B1/B2 but the detailed text says the language is only an advantage or routine written communication, store both pieces of evidence and rank from the stricter verified reality instead of blindly trusting one field.

developmentChanges.title: Temporary-role value-density score
developmentChanges.reason: Score seasonal/short-term roles by hourly pay, schedule compatibility, transferable target skills and application effort so low-paid temporary listings do not crowd out stronger permanent e-commerce/admin opportunities.

developmentChanges.title: Source-family query coverage fingerprint
developmentChanges.reason: Persist the query themes actually used per source family so repeated runs can detect blind spots instead of repeatedly searching the same narrow wording and falsely appearing diverse.

developmentChanges.title: Candidate evidence-expiry queue
developmentChanges.reason: Track when canonical evidence for location, remote policy, language and activity was last confirmed and automatically prioritize near-expiry high-fit candidates for recheck before they can become stale recommendations.

developmentChanges.title: Non-English market hard-gate extractor
developmentChanges.reason: Detect roles whose customer market itself implies a mandatory language such as French, German or Hungarian even when the job title is generic customer support; reject before expensive deep verification unless that language is compatible with the profile.

developmentChanges.title: Closed-variant sibling suppression
developmentChanges.reason: When one indexed role family has several near-identical language/technical variants and some are explicitly closed, cluster siblings by employer+role family so stale closed variants do not inflate candidate counts or source-success metrics.
